say:0:1120633001:0.text: ... Something's different about these shrubs. They look a bit shorter than the ones we've seen in other places.
say:0:1120633001:0.source_cn: ……这片灌木有些异常，比其他地点的更矮。
say:0:1120633001:0.male: ... Something's different about these shrubs. They look a bit shorter than the ones we've seen in other places.
say:0:1120633001:0.female: ... Something's different about these shrubs. They look a bit shorter than the ones we've seen in other places.

say:1:1120633002:0.text: Their roots don't seem to run very deep either, which means they haven't had much time to grow.
say:1:1120633002:0.source_cn: 它们的根系也比其他灌木丛浅，生长的时间更短。
say:1:1120633002:0.male: Their roots don't seem to run very deep either, which means they haven't had much time to grow.
say:1:1120633002:0.female: Their roots don't seem to run very deep either, which means they haven't had much time to grow.

say:2:1120633003:0.text: Oh, Chippy knows why! It's because someone dug this place up recently! The treasure must be hidden right here!
say:2:1120633003:0.source_cn: 满满知道了！是因为有人挖开过这里！宝藏一定就在这里！
